# Zoggyfin

> Zoggyfin is a free client app for Jellyfin media servers. It runs on iPhone, iPad, Mac (Apple silicon) and Fire TV, Google TV and Android TV. It plays movies, shows, music and audiobooks from your own Jellyfin server (version 10.11 or later), with downloads for offline play and watch and listen together. It has no account of its own and collects no data. Zoggyfin is made by Zog Tech, Inc. and is not affiliated with the Jellyfin project. The sections below link to Markdown pages. Read llms-full.txt to guide a user through install, setup and use in one file.

## Docs

- [Support](https://zoggyfin.zog-tech.com/support.md): sign-in, addresses, playback, downloads and watch together
